meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Dieter Rams 的十条「好设计」原则逐条给 0–3 分并附证据,给出 NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN 结论,再输出一段可直接运行的 /make-plan 提示词,全部产物写入 DESIGN-IS-日期/ 目录。它不写实现代码。
howto.when: 当你说「audit this design」「design review」「design audit」等,或要求做一次应当接出计划的评审时触发。日常 UI 代码审查请走 /review。

say.text: 审计这个设计,对照 Rams 十条原则逐条打分
say.note: 每条附证据,并给出总结论

say.text: 这个设计还不存在,直接产出从零开始的计划
say.note: 跳过证据阶段,判为 NEW

howto.what_en: Audits a design against Dieter Rams' ten principles: scores each 0-3 with cited evidence, issues a NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN verdict, and writes a copy-pasteable /make-plan prompt into DESIGN-IS-<date>/. It writes no implementation code.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "audit this design", "design review", "design audit", etc., or any critique request that should lead to a plan. Routine UI code review should use /review instead.

say_en.text: Audit this design against Rams' ten principles, scoring each
say_en.note: Each score cites evidence; a verdict follows

say_en.text: Review this UI and give me NEW, REFINE, or REDESIGN
